en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard. The front shows four photographs: a modern building complex on a forested hillside; a central city square with a large domed former mosque and an equestrian statue; a panoramic view over a hilly town with people sitting on a slope in the foreground; and a stone lookout platform with railings overlooking rolling hills. The back side has handwritten Hungarian text in blue ink, printed publisher information, a PÉCS postmark, and an address field.
